title: US Foods to Host Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call and Webcast
summary: US Foods Holding Corp. (NYSE: USFD) will host a live conference call and webcast to discuss second quarter 2026 results on Thursday, August 6, 2026, at 8 a.m. CDT. The conference call can be accessed live over the phone by dialing (888) 660-6196. Listeners should dial in 10 minutes prior to the call start time and provide the Conference ID USFDQ226 to be connected. A replay will be available after the call. To listen to a replay of the conference call, please register by clicking this link . The conference call also will be webcast live from the company’s Investor Relations website at https://ir.usfoods.com . The presentation slides that will be reviewed during the webcast will be available in the Events Presentations section of the Investor Relations website before the webcast begins.
